metadata.description: GPT design-to-assets skill for Claude Code

plugins.name: gpt-ui-assets
plugins.description: Design platform-native app UIs with GPT and turn them into production assets: every icon, illustration and background redrawn 1:1 (never cropped), SVG/VectorDrawable icons, app icons, frame/Lottie/AVD animation, fonts, theme code and a screenshot diff for a 1:1 build.

plugins.name: attachment-preview
plugins.description: Terminal pane to review generated images: variant grids, side-by-side compare, transparent assets on checker/light/dark, icon contact sheets, aspect and QA at a glance.
